title: spec review: Q2 v2: orchestrator/planner_telemetry.py — per-invocation Planner rows (launch, usage, materiality, skips), per-goal and per-accepted-goal Fable/Opus aggregation, interactive transcript attribution by day overlap (P1)
spec:
Why: headless Planner usage is logged only as bus.log_run role planner_decision rows (planner_runs._record_decision_usage, lines 566-620) with no model, decision type or materiality; interactive Fable transcript tokens are pool-wide (Pool.tally_planner -> planner_usage.json, scorecard.planner_footer) with no per-goal share. The brief (P1) needs Planner tokens per material decision and Fable tokens per accepted goal. Spec review T-0677's five risks are folded in (constraints.fix_round_for, result_escalate field, day-overlap attribution, root resolution, plan.md location).
What: new module orchestrator/planner_telemetry.py using schedlog.append/read (files runs/sched/planner_invocations.jsonl and runs/sched/planner_skips.jsonl). Rows never contain prompts, transcripts or chain-of-thought; free text fields capped at 300 chars. Every function takes root=None and resolves `root = Path(root) if root is not None else STATE` first; schedlog writes go under root/runs/sched via a context manager like decision_log._using_root (orchestrator/decision_log.py:57-84).
- record_launch(*, launch_id, goal_id, event, decision_type, kind, payload_keys, model, tier, account, complexity, band, task_class, architectural, route, route_reason, mode, state_version, packet_chars, started_at, reescalation=False, root=None) -> row phase "launch".
- record_usage(launch_id, *, input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, cache_read_tokens=0, cache_write_tokens=0, usd=None, latency_s=None, outcome, session_id=None, root=None) -> row phase "usage"; total_tokens = input + output + cache_read // 10 (pool formula, Pool.tally_planner).
- snapshot(goal_id, root=None) -> {"tasks": {task_id: {"status", "depends_on", "hold_reason", "fix_round_for" (from (task.get("constraints") or {}).get("fix_round_for")), "result_escalate" (bool((task.get("result") or {}).get("escalate"))), "parent", "created_at"}} over the goal and its children read from root/tasks/*.json, "plan_hash": sha256 of root/plan.md text or None}.
- materiality(before, after) -> {"material": bool, "new_tasks": [ids in after not in before], "dependencies_changed": [ids whose depends_on differ], "fix_strategy_for": [ids that gained a child with fix_round_for == id], "escalated": bool (any task whose hold_reason newly contains 'escalat', or whose result_escalate turned True, or the goal itself newly held/failed), "plan_changed": plan_hash differs}; material when any list non-empty or plan_changed or escalated. record_materiality(launch_id, before, after, root=None) -> row phase "materiality".
- record_skip(*, goal_id, event, reason, kind=None, payload_key=None, root=None) -> row in planner_skips.
- read_invocations(root=None) -> list of merged dicts, one per launch_id, later phases overriding earlier fields; read_invocations_with_malformed(root=None) -> (rows, malformed_count).
- per_goal(goal_id, root=None) -> {"planner_tokens", "fable_tokens", "opus_tokens", "other_tokens", "calls", "fable_calls", "opus_calls", "escalations" (rows with tier fable and route escalate), "reescalations", "material_decisions", "tokens_per_material_decision" (None when 0 material), "skips", "usd"}; tier buckets fable/opus/other.
- accepted_goal_summary(root=None) -> over scorecard.accepted_goals(root) (root already resolved): {"n_goals", "planner_tokens_per_accepted_goal", "fable_tokens_per_accepted_goal", "fable_calls_per_accepted_goal", "fable_share", "planner_tokens_per_material_decision", "planner_usd_per_accepted_goal"}; None values when no goals.
- interactive_by_goal(root=None, cfg=None, now=None, days=30) -> list of {"goal_id", "days": [iso dates], "tokens", "model", "model_source": "assumed_models_planner", "method": "day_overlap_approximate"}: cfg defaults to bus.pool_config(); call planner_runs._interactive_summary(root, cfg, cutoff=now - days*86400, now, headless=[]) and use its day_totals ([{day, account, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, ...}]); tokens per day = pool formula; for each day split that day's tokens across the goals (role triage, no parent) open during that day, proportionally to the seconds each goal was open within the day (created_at .. its done event ts or now); a day with no open goal is reported under goal_id None. Documented as an approximation in the docstring and the method field.
acceptance: tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_launch_usage_materiality_merge_by_launch_id — three phases for one launch_id read back as one row with model, total_tokens (cache_read // 10 formula) and material fields

tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_materiality_detects_new_task_dependency_change_and_fix_strategy — snapshots before/after with a new child whose constraints.fix_round_for names a held task and a changed depends_on give material True, list both and name the held id under fix_strategy_for; identical snapshots give material False; a result flag escalate flips escalated

tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_per_goal_splits_fable_and_opus_tokens — two invocations (tier fable, tier opus) and one skip give fable_tokens, opus_tokens, calls 2, skips 1, tokens_per_material_decision computed only over material rows

tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_accepted_goal_summary_per_accepted_goal — two accepted goals with invocations under a sandbox root give fable_tokens_per_accepted_goal and fable_share; no accepted goals gives None values without raising

tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_interactive_by_goal_day_overlap_is_marked_approximate — with planner_runs._interactive_summary patched to return two day_totals rows, tokens split across two goals open on those days proportionally to open seconds, every row carries method day_overlap_approximate and model_source assumed_models_planner, and a malformed invocations line is counted by read_invocations_with_malformed

risks.issue: Spec directs reuse of decision_log._using_root's pattern (decision_log.py:64-74) for root-scoping schedlog writes: a bare try/finally reassignment of the module global schedlog.SCHED_DIR, with no lock. daemon.py genuinely runs concurrent background threads for dispatch (daemon.py:481 spawn_async -> threading.Thread(...).start(), used for executor.start/spawn.run_worker), so two threads calling record_launch/record_usage/record_materiality/record_skip (or racing against decision_log.record or another schedlog consumer) with different root values can interleave: thread A sets SCHED_DIR to its root, thread B overwrites it mid-write, and A's row lands in B's directory (or a test sandbox root leaks into production STATE, or vice versa). This exact hazard was already hit once in this codebase: orchestrator/sched_scorecard.py's _sched_rows (lines 29-36) does the identical global swap but wraps it in threading.Lock() (_READ_LOCK, line 16) specifically to prevent this race. The spec should point at sched_scorecard's locked pattern, or planner_telemetry.py should add its own lock around the schedlog.SCHED_DIR swap, not copy decision_log's unlocked one.

snapshot()/materiality() treat plan_hash (sha256 of root/plan.md) as a per-goal signal, but plan.md is a single shared checkpoint file for the whole Planner session (STATE/plan.md, written by _retrospective and handover.py, confirmed by this worktree's own git log showing a new goal opened in the same plan.md while other goals were still closing). Any edit to a different, unrelated goal's section of plan.md changes the hash and will flip plan_changed (hence material=True) for every goal snapshotted around that time, and materiality's escalated check for 'the goal itself newly held/failed' has the same cross-goal contamination risk if it inspects shared plan.md content. None of the five acceptance tests exercise a multi-goal plan.md, so this ships unverified and will produce inflated/wrong material_decisions counts and tokens_per_material_decision for goals that had no actual plan change of their own.

The literal call given for interactive_by_goal, planner_runs._interactive_summary(root, cfg, cutoff=now - days*86400, now, headless=[]), is a SyntaxError as written (keyword argument cutoff= followed by positional now) against the real signature _interactive_summary(root, cfg, cutoff, now, headless) at planner_runs.py:794. Confirmed by reproducing the exact call shape in a throwaway interpreter. Trivial fix (drop the cutoff= keyword, pass positionally, or name all four), but as written an implementer copying it verbatim won't compile.

suggested_spec_changes: Have planner_telemetry.py guard its schedlog.SCHED_DIR root-swap with a module-level threading.Lock(), mirroring orchestrator/sched_scorecard.py's _sched_rows/_READ_LOCK, instead of copying decision_log._using_root verbatim.

Scope plan_changed to the goal's own section of plan.md (e.g. hash only the text between that goal's markers, or diff task-derived state only) rather than hashing the whole shared file, or explicitly document and accept the cross-goal false-positive and drop plan_changed from the material determination.
Fix the _interactive_summary call example to valid positional syntax: planner_runs._interactive_summary(root, cfg, now - days*86400, now, headless=[]).
